log.name: Applied Intuition
log.note: Replaced Abnormal Security (MD: 'not good') and screened out Bridgestone (incoming sole FE tire supplier 2026-27 = deepest already_present; lost F1 tender; mature public incumbent, not our pre-IPO profile). Applied Intuition is a $15B/~$830M-ARR physical-AI & vehicle-software leader whose customers are 18 of the top 20 automakers - the F1 paddock is its exact B2B buyer base, and 'physical AI / autonomy' is an unclaimed grid lane (distinct from generic-AI deals: Anthropic-Williams, TWG-Cadillac). Honest MODE-B fit: brand+audience+engineering adjacency, not an in-car deployment.

log.name: Mistral AI
log.note: Chose the freshest strong FE name over the engine's presumptive Wayve (featured just 5 days ago, only cleared cooldown today). Rebuilt Mistral's lighter record: re-verified live (€11.7B Series C Sep 2025; reportedly raising ~€3B at ~€20B per Bloomberg Jun 2026; $830M debt Mar 2026; CEO Arthur Mensch), corrected the decision-maker title (Jon Bock = SVP Marketing, verified), stamped trust fields (fit_lane/domain, key_facts, thesis, leadership_ties []). Nissan FE AI/LLM lane open. Gate 0 blockers, 2 pages.

log.name: Infineon Technologies
log.note: Today's FE hero at the signal quality bar, built on the recalibrated electrical/electronics profile. Infineon = world #1 auto/power-semiconductor maker (~$17.2B rev, ~$120B cap), SiC leader. REAL in-car workstream: FE powertrains are manufacturer-developed, so SiC sits in Jaguar's traction inverter (the biggest lever on efficiency/thermal/regen) - not a halo. Verified decision PATH: CMO Andreas Urschitz -> CEO Jochen Hanebeck -> Automotive President Peter Schiefer. Screen-outs done: Eaton (FE-relevant eMobility being spun off/declining -> F1 fit), Porsche (TDK+Synopsys occupy electronics), Mahindra (Renesas). Jaguar power-semi lane OPEN. Gate 0 blockers, 2 pages. (Electra 68 + Watershed 70 + Vertiv 82/F1 also generated this day as bench options.)

log.name: Cadence Design Systems
log.note: Fri F1 hero. Cadence = computational-engineering leader; just acquired Hexagon's CFD/multiphysics/structural stack (MSC Nastran, Adams) - the literal toolchain F1 cars are designed with. REAL MODE-A workstream; greenfield Cadillac builds its CAE from zero (PRIME LANE). Decision path: SVP Mktg/BD Nimish Modi -> CEO Anirudh Devgan. 0 blockers, 2pp.

log.name: Eaton
log.note: Sat F1 hero. Eaton = intelligent-power-management leader (record $27.4B FY25) on the electrification + AI-power supercycle; nVent electrical thread at scale, public. Real workstream: electrical backbone of Aston's new campus/wind-tunnel/sim + trackside; electrical lane OPEN. Decision path: CEO Paulo Ruiz + Marcomms Dir Camie Hanily. 0 blockers, 2pp.

Versigent archetype at larger scale, on-profile, real race-car-relevant workstream, brand-build motive. CEO Philipp von Hirschheydt + CFO Jutta Donges. Williams electronics/SDV lane OPEN. 0 blockers, 2pp, HOT 77.

HONEST: marquee brand/future-energy halo (fusion not team-deployable) - MODE-B, scored 71 WARM (ops_fit 11). Andretti (American, sustainability, charter) lane OPEN. Decision-maker CEO Bob Mumgaard. 0 blockers, 2pp.

CEO Mati Staniszewski. 0 blockers, 2pp. (Other ICONIQ-recent screened: Quince consumer, Whirl seed, Hightouch/UnifyApps weak fit, Ramp approached, Xona early-stage.)
